title: Machinery
description: A high-performance industrial plugin that adds tiered resource production to Pistons and enhanced redstone signals to Hoppers and Crafters.
body:
## ⚙️ **Machinery**
**Industrialize your world with smart automation and tiered resource processing.** **Machinery** is a high-performance Spigot/Paper plugin designed to bridge the gap between vanilla redstone and industrial modpacks. By introducing "Piston Pressing" and enhanced redstone logic, it gives players a reason to build massive, profitable factories while keeping server performance a top priority.

### 🛠️ **Features**
* **The Piston Press:** Transform any downward-facing piston into a resource generator. When positioned over a hopper, the piston "crushes" out ores.
* **6 Tiered Progression:** Start with Coal and work your way up to Netherite. Each tier is fully customizable for drop rates and sounds.
* **Vault Economy Integration:** Seamlessly works with **EssentialsX** or any Vault-based economy. Players spend money to upgrade their machinery
* **Visual Flair:** Includes custom particles and built-in "floating text" (holograms) using vanilla ArmorStands—no extra dependencies required!
* **Lag-Free Design:** Developed with heavy caching and optimized event handling to ensure 20.0 TPS even on the busiest servers.

### 📜 **Commands**
* **Shift + Right-Click a Piston:** Open the Upgrade Menu.
* `/machinery reload`: Instantly refresh configuration settings.
* `/machinery give <player> <tier>`: Spawn custom tiered pistons for rewards or shops.

### 🔑 **Permissions**
* `machinery.upgrade`: Allows players to access the upgrade GUI.
* `machinery.admin`: Full access to reload and give commands.
